staking_policy_priority.name: Coinbase staking and Prime LsETH docs

us_equity.tax_note: record dividends and capital gains; not tax advice
us_equity.market_hours_note: respect US regular session and liquidity

crypto.tax_note: record spot trades, staking rewards, and stablecoin conversions; not tax advice
crypto.market_hours_note: 24/7 market, but liquidity and venue risk vary

expected_value_policy.formula: EV = p_up * upside_target_pct - p_down * downside_stop_pct - friction_pct

crypto_long_term_core.notes: Yield-aware long-term crypto core. BTC is a smaller dynamic diversification anchor: 3-5% initial, 5-8% mature, 8-12% only in risk-off/staking uncertainty, hard cap 15%. ETH-like and high-quality PoS assets can carry larger long-term weight when staking/liquidity risks are verified.

us_equity_long_term_core.notes: US common stocks and non-levered ETFs only.

tactical_spot.notes: Short-term tactical opportunities. Leveraged ETFs are allowed only under the restricted tactical policy; no options, inverse ETFs, margin, or shorting.

cash_and_stablecoin_reserve.notes: Minimum opportunity liquidity, not long-term idle cash. Excess capital should work in DCA assets or reviewed cash-like spot instruments.
